  sphere(scene, Math.cos(a) * 3.1, 0.25, 13.7 + Math.sin(a) * 3.1, 0.3, leafMats[i % 4], 8);
}

const benchWood = mat('#a77b51'), binMat = mat('#55716a');
for (const [x, z, r] of [[-5, -8, 0], [5, 8, Math.PI], [-17, 0, Math.PI / 2], [17, 0, -Math.PI / 2]]) {
  const g = new THREE.Group();
  g.position.set(x, 0, z);
  g.rotation.y = r;
  scene.add(g);
  box(g, 0, 0.58, 0, 1.35, 0.13, 0.42, benchWood);
  for (const xx of [-0.5, 0.5]) {
    box(g, xx, 0.32, 0, 0.1, 0.52, 0.1, lampMat);
    box(g, xx, 0.78, -0.19, 0.1, 0.42, 0.09, benchWood);
  }
  box(g, 1.15, 0.42, 0.15, 0.45, 0.82, 0.45, binMat);
}

const signG = new THREE.Group();
signG.position.set(-2.2, 0, -8);
scene.add(signG);
cyl(signG, 0, 0.8, 0, 0.08, 0.08, 1.6, trunkMat, 8);
box(signG, 0, 1.63, 0, 2.1, 0.72, 0.16, mat('#314a40'));
box(signG, 0, 1.63, 0.1, 1.92, 0.54, 0.04, mat('#d7ed9b'));

const staticColliders = [...houses, { x: -6.3, z: -4.55, rx: 1.45, rz: 0.8, top: 1.5 }, { x: 6.4, z: 4.55, rx: 1.45, rz: 0.8, top: 1.5 }, { x: 4.55, z: -12.1, rx: 0.8, rz: 1.45, top: 1.5 }];
const definitions = {
  crate: { label: 'Wood crate', radius: 0.69, mass: 1.55, bounce: 0.34, color: '#c58b53' },
  ball: { label: 'Super ball', radius: 0.61, mass: 0.55, bounce: 0.84, color: '#ee765a' },
  barrel: { label: 'Oil drum', radius: 0.62, mass: 1.25, bounce: 0.28, color: '#587f7d' },
  rock: { label: 'Big rock', radius: 0.78, mass: 2.5, bounce: 0.18, color: '#777d73' }
};
const bodies = [];
let selected = 'crate';
let gravityOn = true;
let paused = false;
let power = 1;
let impact = 0;
let lastImpactAt = 0;

function makeBody(kind, position, velocity = new THREE.Vector3()) {
  const d = definitions[kind];
  let mesh;
  if (kind === 'crate') {
    mesh = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(1.16, 1.16, 1.16), mat(d.color, 0.9));
    mesh.add(new THREE.LineSegments(new THREE.EdgesGeometry(mesh.geometry), new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({ color: '#815936', transparent: true, opacity: 0.65 })));
  } else if (kind === 'ball') {
    mesh = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(d.radius, 20, 14), new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: d.color, roughness: 0.25 }));
    for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
      const stripe = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TorusGeometry(d.radius * 0.72, 0.035, 6, 36), mat('#fff1d2', 0.4));
      stripe.rotation.set(i * Math.PI / 2, 0, i * Math.PI / 2);
      mesh.add(stripe);
    }
  } else if (kind === 'barrel') {
    mesh = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.52, 0.52, 1.3, 16), new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: d.color, roughness: 0.47, metalness: 0.26 }));
    for (const y of [-0.38, 0.38]) {
      const hoop = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TorusGeometry(0.525, 0.045, 6, 16), mat('#bcc4b3', 0.35, 0.5));
      hoop.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2;
      hoop.position.y = y;
      mesh.add(hoop);
    }
  } else {
    mesh = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.DodecahedronGeometry(0.68, 1), mat(d.color, 1));
    mesh.scale.set(1.12, 0.92, 1);
  }
  mesh.castShadow = true;
  mesh.receiveShadow = true;
  mesh.position.copy(position);
  scene.add(mesh);
  const body = {
    kind,
    mesh,
    pos: position.clone(),
    vel: velocity.clone(),
    rotVel: new THREE.Vector3((Math.random() - 0.5) * 1.5, (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1.5, (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1.5),
    radius: d.radius,
    mass: d.mass,
    bounce: d.bounce,
    sleep: 0
  };
  bodies.push(body);
  if (bodies.length > 40) {
    const old = bodies.shift();
    scene.remove(old.mesh);
    old.mesh.geometry.dispose();
  }
  document.querySelector('#objectCount').textContent = bodies.length;
  return body;
}

function collideTown(b) {
  const r = b.radius;
  for (const c of staticColliders) {
    const dx = b.pos.x - c.x;
    const dz = b.pos.z - c.z;
    const px = c.rx + r - Math.abs(dx);
    const pz = c.rz + r - Math.abs(dz);
    if (px > 0 && pz > 0 && b.pos.y - r < c.top && b.pos.y + r > 0.08) {
      if (px < pz) {
        b.pos.x += dx >= 0 ? px : -px;
        if ((dx >= 0 ? b.vel.x : -b.vel.x) < 0) b.vel.x = -b.vel.x * 0.55;
      } else {
        b.pos.z += dz >= 0 ? pz : -pz;
        if ((dz >= 0 ? b.vel.z : -b.vel.z) < 0) b.vel.z = -b.vel.z * 0.55;
      }
      b.vel.multiplyScalar(0.94);
      b.sleep = 0;
    }
  }
  for (const [x, z] of [...treePositions, ...lampPositions]) {
    const dx = b.pos.x - x;
    const dz = b.pos.z - z;
    const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
    const min = r + 0.31;
    if (dist < min && b.pos.y < 2.1) {
      const nx = dx / (dist || 0.001);
      const nz = dz / (dist || 0.001);
      b.pos.x = x + nx * min;
      b.pos.z = z + nz * min;
      const vn = b.vel.x * nx + b.vel.z * nz;
      if (vn < 0) {
        b.vel.x -= 1.55 * vn * nx;
        b.vel.z -= 1.55 * vn * nz;
      }
      b.sleep = 0;
    }
  }
}

function physics(dt) {
  const step = dt / 2;
  for (let s = 0; s < 2; s++) {
    for (const b of bodies) {
      if (b.sleep > 1.3) continue;
      if (gravityOn) b.vel.y -= 17 * step;
      b.pos.addScaledVector(b.vel, step);
      b.mesh.rotation.x += b.rotVel.x * step;
      b.mesh.rotation.y += b.rotVel.y * step;
      b.mesh.rotation.z += b.rotVel.z * step;

      const floorY = b.radius;
      if (b.pos.y < floorY) {
        b.pos.y = floorY;
        if (b.vel.y < -0.6) {
          const speed = Math.abs(b.vel.y);
          if (speed > 4 && performance.now() - lastImpactAt > 220) {
            impact = Math.max(impact, Math.round(speed * 3.6));
            lastImpactAt = performance.now();
          }
          b.vel.y = -b.vel.y * b.bounce;
          b.vel.x *= 0.82;
          b.vel.z *= 0.82;
          b.rotVel.x += b.vel.z * 0.06;
          b.rotVel.z -= b.vel.x * 0.06;
          if (Math.abs(b.vel.y) < 1.05) b.vel.y = 0;
        } else {
          b.vel.y = 0;
        }
        b.vel.x *= Math.pow(0.86, step * 60);
        b.vel.z *= Math.pow(0.86, step * 60);
        b.rotVel.multiplyScalar(0.97);
      }
      if (Math.abs(b.pos.x) > 25) {
        b.pos.x = Math.sign(b.pos.x) * 25;
        b.vel.x *= -0.6;
      }
      if (Math.abs(b.pos.z) > 23) {
        b.pos.z = Math.sign(b.pos.z) * 23;
        b.vel.z *= -0.6;
      }

      collideTown(b);
      b.vel.multiplyScalar(Math.pow(0.997, step * 60));
      if (b.vel.length() < 0.09 && b.pos.y <= floorY + 0.015) b.sleep += step;
      else b.sleep = 0;
      b.mesh.position.copy(b.pos);
      document.querySelector('#impactValue').textContent = impact;
    }

    for (let i = 0; i < bodies.length; i++) {
      for (let j = i + 1; j < bodies.length; j++) {
        const a = bodies[i], b = bodies[j];
        const dx = b.pos.x - a.pos.x;
        const dy = b.pos.y - a.pos.y;
        const dz = b.pos.z - a.pos.z;
        const d = Math.hypot(dx, dy, dz);
        const min = a.radius + b.radius;
        if (d < min && d > 0.001) {
          const nx = dx / d;
          const ny = dy / d;
          const nz = dz / d;
          const o = min - d;
          a.pos.x -= nx * o * 0.5;
          a.pos.y -= ny * o * 0.5;
          a.pos.z -= nz * o * 0.5;
          b.pos.x += nx * o * 0.5;
          b.pos.y += ny * o * 0.5;
          b.pos.z += nz * o * 0.5;
          const rel = (b.vel.x - a.vel.x) * nx + (b.vel.y - a.vel.y) * ny + (b.vel.z - a.vel.z) * nz;
          if (rel < 0) {
            const jn = -(1 + Math.min(a.bounce, b.bounce)) * rel / (1 / a.mass + 1 / b.mass);
            a.vel.x -= jn * nx / a.mass;
            a.vel.y -= jn * ny / a.mass;
            a.vel.z -= jn * nz / a.mass;
            b.vel.x += jn * nx / b.mass;
            b.vel.y += jn * ny / b.mass;
            b.vel.z += jn * nz / b.mass;
            if (Math.abs(rel) > 4) {
              impact = Math.max(impact, Math.round(Math.abs(rel) * 3.6));
              lastImpactAt = performance.now();
            }
          }
          a.sleep = b.sleep = 0;
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

const ui = {
  power: document.querySelector('#power'),
  powerLabel: document.querySelector('#powerLabel'),
  gravityBtn: document.querySelector('#gravityBtn'),
  playBtn: document.querySelector('#playBtn'),
  playText: document.querySelector('#playText'),
  resetBtn: document.querySelector('#resetBtn'),
  objectCount: document.querySelector('#objectCount'),
  impactValue: document.querySelector('#impactValue'),
  clock: document.querySelector('#clock'),
  toast: document.querySelector('#toast'),
  zoomIn: document.querySelector('#zoomIn'),
  zoomOut: document.querySelector('#zoomOut'),
  homeView: document.querySelector('#homeView')
};

function updatePowerUi() {
  ui.powerLabel.textContent = `${Math.round(power * 100)}%`;
}

function setSelected(kind) {
  selected = kind;
  document.querySelectorAll('.tool').forEach(el => el.classList.toggle('active', el.dataset.kind === kind));
}

function showToast(message) {
  ui.toast.textContent = message;
  ui.toast.classList.add('show');
  clearTimeout(showToast._timer);
  showToast._timer = setTimeout(() => ui.toast.classList.remove('show'), 900);
}

function resetTown() {
  for (const body of bodies) {
    scene.remove(body.mesh);
    body.mesh.geometry.dispose?.();
  }
  bodies.length = 0;
  ui.objectCount.textContent = '0';
  impact = 0;
  ui.impactValue.textContent = '0';
  setSelected(selected);
}

function seedTown() {
  makeBody('crate', new THREE.Vector3(-2.5, 1.4, -3.5), new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 0));
  makeBody('ball', new THREE.Vector3(2.5, 1.15, 1.3), new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 0));
  makeBody('barrel', new THREE.Vector3(-1.5, 1.2, 8), new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 0));
}

const raycaster = new THREE.Raycaster();
const groundPlane = new THREE.Plane(new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0), -0.1);
const dragState = { active: false, pos: new THREE.Vector3(), start: new THREE.Vector3(), current: new THREE.Vector3() };
let orbiting = false;
let lastPointer = { x: 0, y: 0 };

function screenToGround(clientX, clientY) {
  const x = (clientX / innerWidth) * 2 - 1;
  const y = -(clientY / innerHeight) * 2 + 1;
  raycaster.setFromCamera(new THREE.Vector2(x, y), camera);
  const point = new THREE.Vector3();
  raycaster.ray.intersectPlane(groundPlane, point);
  return point;
}

function launchFromDrag() {
  if (!dragState.active) return;
  const delta = dragState.start.clone().sub(dragState.current);
  const travel = Math.hypot(delta.x, delta.z, delta.y);
  if (travel < 0.35) {
    dragState.active = false;
    return;
  }

  const velocity = new THREE.Vector3(
    delta.x * (2.4 + power * 1.1),
    Math.max(1.2, delta.y * 2.4 + 3.3),
    delta.z * (2.4 + power * 1.1)
  );
  const spawn = dragState.start.clone();
  spawn.x = clamp(spawn.x, -21, 21);
  spawn.z = clamp(spawn.z, -20, 20);
  spawn.y = 1.1;
  const body = makeBody(selected, spawn, velocity);
  body.mesh.position.copy(spawn);
  body.pos.copy(spawn);
  showToast(`${definitions[selected].label} launched`);
  dragState.active = false;
}

canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', (event) => {
  if (event.button === 2) {
    orbiting = true;
    lastPointer.x = event.clientX;
    lastPointer.y = event.clientY;
    canvas.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
    return;
  }

  if (event.button !== 0) return;
  const groundPoint = screenToGround(event.clientX, event.clientY);
  dragState.active = true;
  dragState.start.copy(groundPoint);
  dragState.current.copy(groundPoint);
});

canvas.addEventListener('pointermove', (event) => {
  if (orbiting) {
    const dx = event.clientX - lastPointer.x;
    const dy = event.clientY - lastPointer.y;
    lastPointer.x = event.clientX;
    lastPointer.y = event.clientY;
    azimuth -= dx * 0.005;
    polar = clamp(polar + dy * 0.0035, 0.4, 1.4);
    updateCamera();
    return;
  }

  if (dragState.active) {
    dragState.current.copy(screenToGround(event.clientX, event.clientY));
  }
});

canvas.addEventListener('pointerup', (event) => {
  if (orbiting) {
    orbiting = false;
    canvas.releasePointerCapture(event.pointerId);
    return;
  }
  if (dragState.active) launchFromDrag();
});

canvas.addEventListener('pointerleave', () => {
  if (orbiting) orbiting = false;
  if (dragState.active) launchFromDrag();
});
canvas.addEventListener('contextmenu', (event) => event.preventDefault());

ui.power.addEventListener('input', (event) => {
  power = Number(event.target.value) / 100;
  updatePowerUi();
});

ui.gravityBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
  gravityOn = !gravityOn;
  ui.gravityBtn.classList.toggle('off', !gravityOn);
});

ui.playBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
  paused = !paused;
  ui.playText.textContent = paused ? 'SIMULATION PAUSED' : 'SIMULATION LIVE';
  ui.playBtn.querySelector('.live-dot').style.opacity = paused ? '0.4' : '1';
});

ui.resetBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
  resetTown();
  seedTown();
  showToast('Town reset');
});

ui.zoomIn.addEventListener('click', () => {
  radius = clamp(radius - 3.5, 15, 75);
  updateCamera();
});

ui.zoomOut.addEventListener('click', () => {
  radius = clamp(radius + 3.5, 15, 75);
  updateCamera();
});

ui.homeView.addEventListener('click', () => {
  radius = 40;
  azimuth = Math.PI * 0.25;
  polar = 1.02;
  updateCamera();
});

document.querySelectorAll('.tool').forEach(button => {
  button.addEventListener('click', () => setSelected(button.dataset.kind));
});

document.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => {
  const key = event.key.toLowerCase();
  if (key === '1') setSelected('crate');
  if (key === '2') setSelected('ball');
  if (key === '3') setSelected('barrel');
  if (key === '4') setSelected('rock');
  if (key === 'r') {
    resetTown();
    seedTown();
    showToast('Town reset');
  }
  if (key === ' ') {
    paused = !paused;
    ui.playText.textContent = paused ? 'SIMULATION PAUSED' : 'SIMULATION LIVE';
    ui.playBtn.querySelector('.live-dot').style.opacity = paused ? '0.4' : '1';
  }
});

function updateClock() {
  const now = new Date();
  const minutes = now.getMinutes().toString().padStart(2, '0');
  const hours = now.getHours().toString().padStart(2, '0');
  ui.clock.textContent = `${hours}:${minutes}`;
}

function animate() {
  requestAnimationFrame(animate);

  const dt = Math.min(0.033, 1 / 60);
  if (!paused) physics(dt);
  updateCamera();
  renderer.render(scene, camera);
  updateClock();
}

updatePowerUi();
resetTown();
seedTown();
updateClock();
animate();
</script>
</body>
</html>
